name: Wonzimer
about_text: Wönzimer is an independent gallery in Lincoln Heights, Los Angeles, founded by Swiss artist Alaïa Parhizi and American entrepreneur Aidan Nelson. Its German name, meaning "living room," reflects the founders' aim to create an intimate, home-like exhibition space rather than a conventional white-box gallery. The gallery represents thirteen artists working across painting, sculpture, and mixed media, and presents both solo shows and thematic group exhibitions that bring together established and emerging voices, including international projects. Beyond exhibitions, Wönzimer runs W.A.R.P., an artist residency program with on-site studios, and hosts artist talks, poetry readings, music, film screenings, and other cross-disciplinary programming. The space includes a hidden bookshelf leading to a lounge, continuing the gallery's living-room concept. Wönzimer has operated from earlier locations in Koreatown and downtown Los Angeles before settling in its current Lincoln Heights space.

triage.site_notes: This Wix-based site has no consolidated exhibitions archive list; instead each show and each dated event under /events/YYYY/M/D/ has its own page, which together form a de facto chronological archive from 2020-2026. Artist pages are scattered individually (no single roster listing page beyond the thin /artist page), so representative artist pages were labeled; about and contact pages are standard single pages.
